title: Discovery of the New World’s Oldest Extant Metal-Type–Printed Book in Korea through Image Acquisition, Comparison, and Analysis
version: Digital Studies/Le champ numérique 14(1), pp. 1–22; CC BY 4.0 author version
lineage: Secondary synthesis estimates date from earlier Korean literature; does not independently examine a surviving Sangjeong copy. The paper’s separate identification of another printed book is disputed and is not adopted here.

passages.quote: are estimated to have been printed between 1234 and 1241
passages.note: Refers to 28 copies of Sangjeong Gogeum Yemun; states no copies have been found.
